The Project Gutenberg EBook of Sample Text, by Anonymous

This is a minimal sample text file for testing purposes.
It contains enough English words to exercise the NLP benchmark scripts.

CHAPTER I

It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom,
it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of
incredulity, it was the season of Light, it was the season of Darkness, it was
the spring of hope, it was the winter of despair, we had everything before us,
we had nothing before us, we were all going direct to Heaven, we were all going
direct the other way.

There is no point in using a lot of words when a few will do.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.
How vividly glistening moonlight dapples quiet water.
Bright stars sparkle above rolling meadows at night.
The wandering pilgrim sought wisdom in distant mountains.
Every word has meaning beyond mere letters on a page.

CHAPTER II

Once upon a time in a land far away there lived a wise old wizard.
He had spent many years studying the ancient arts of language and letters.
His library contained thousands of books filled with stories and poems.
Every morning he would read aloud from his favorite volumes.

The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
Birds sing sweetly in the branches of tall trees.
Rivers flow downhill toward the sea always finding their path.
Mountains stand firm against the passing storms of centuries.
Children laugh and play in gardens full of flowers.

CHAPTER III

Words are the building blocks of all human communication.
Language allows us to share thoughts feelings and ideas.
Poetry captures the beauty of the world in carefully chosen words.
Stories transport us to places we have never been.
Reading expands the mind and enriches the spirit.

The alphabet contains twenty six letters in English.
Each letter can be combined with others to form words.
Words combine into sentences that express complete thoughts.
Sentences form paragraphs that develop ideas over several lines.
Paragraphs form chapters that explore topics in depth.

Knowledge is the greatest treasure one can acquire.
A good book is a friend that never disappoints.
The pen is mightier than the sword many have said.
Reading one good book leads naturally to the next.
Every page turned is a step forward in understanding.

CHAPTER IV

In the beginning was the word and the word was with light.
All things were made through the power of language.
Without words the world would be dark and silent.
With words we build civilizations and pass wisdom to our children.
The written word preserves knowledge across generations.

Simple words carry the deepest meanings often.
Love hope peace freedom truth justice mercy compassion grace.
These words have moved nations and changed the course of history.
A single poem can outlast an empire if it speaks to the heart.
Literature is the record of humanity's highest aspirations.

The harvest moon hung low over the autumn fields.
Farmers gathered the last of the season's bounty.
Geese flew south in long formations across the pale sky.
The smell of woodsmoke drifted through the cooling air.
Winter was coming but the memory of summer remained warm.
